title: Non-One-Hot Grant — Static All-Ones Mask Passes Multi-Hot req
bug_signature: UVM_ERROR: [MULTI_GNT] gnt=2'b11 for req=2'b11; non-one-hot grant asserted
rtl: assign gnt = req & mask;  // mask=2'b11 always: gnt copies multi-hot req
expected_root_cause: The mask signal is permanently set to 2'b11, so the AND operation (req & mask) is equivalent to req with no filtering; when both request bits are set the output is 2'b11, violating the one-hot grant requirement.
description: The priority mask is hardcoded to 2'b11 (all-ones); AND-ing req with an all-ones mask returns req unchanged, so when both masters request simultaneously gnt becomes 2'b11 violating the one-hot requirement.
failure_log: UVM_ERROR: [MULTI_GNT] gnt=2'b11 for req=2'b11; non-one-hot grant asserted
success_log: gnt always one-hot. req=2'b11 produces gnt=2'b01 (master 0 priority).
